profile.name: 高密度任意波形发生器
profile.description: 这是一种高性能任意波形发生器，用于输出精确定时的可编程模拟波形，并支持序列控制、波形存储和命令表配置。它常用于量子控制实验、脉冲序列生成以及与PQSC等系统同步的QCCS实验平台。
profile.description_en: This is a high-performance arbitrary waveform generator used to produce precisely timed programmable analog waveforms, with support for sequencing, waveform memory, and command-table-based control. It is commonly used in quantum control experiments, pulse sequence generation, and synchronized operation within QCCS setups together with instruments such as the PQSC.
